'''Traveling Racks''' were the slots on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Reconnaissance Troop Transporter]] used to carry [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]],<ref name="ITT comic" /> and sometimes prisoners.<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|pack=Imperial Troop Transporter|link=vintTroopTransport.asp}}</ref>
